photos.title: Riverwalk from above
photos.what: Riverwalk, Myrtle Beach, from above (USDA NAIP aerial photo, 2023): gray-roofed condo buildings in two groups around parking lots, a golf fairway and sand bunkers between the groups, townhomes at the upper left, and the dark Intracoastal Waterway across the bottom with a small pier into it.
photos.caption: Part of Riverwalk from the air. The Intracoastal Waterway runs along the bottom, and Arrowhead Country Club's golf course lies between the buildings.
photos.alt: Aerial photo of the Riverwalk condos in Myrtle Beach: gray-roofed buildings around parking lots, a golf fairway between two groups of them, and the Intracoastal Waterway along the bottom
photos.author: USDA Farm Service Agency, NAIP
photos.provenance: U.S. government aerial photo: USDA National Agriculture Imagery Program (NAIP), South Carolina 2023, natural color, 60 cm. Exported by Chapter3 from the USGS National Map NAIP image service (exportImage, Web Mercator, cubic resampling, mosaic locked to Year=2023) on 2026-11-14; the exact request is in source_request.
photos.license_note: Same source and terms as the NAIP records of /submarkets/garden-city/ (data/2026-11-a/submarkets-garden-city/photos.json): The National Map offers free downloads of public domain NAIP orthoimagery; the USDA FSA policy page says public domain information may be freely distributed or copied, with credit requested.
photos.credit: Photo: USDA Farm Service Agency, NAIP, public domain, via The National Map (USGS).
photos.changes: Chapter3 Realty cut this view from the NAIP service and cropped it to 4:3
photos.subject_check: Looked at full size by the writer of /submarkets/myrtle-beach/riverwalk/ on 2026-11-14. The buildings in the frame are Riverwalk's condo buildings and townhomes, with the Arrowhead Country Club fairway between them and the Intracoastal Waterway at the bottom. No person; no readable sign, plate or house number at page size.
photos.crop_note: Crops cut from the center of a second export of the same frame at 1800 x 1350 (crop_source_request) by tools/photos.js crops, for Article.image and the share image.
